English: I'll handle this.
Do you have anything to confess, Arista?
I have nothing to confess, no!
Go back to your cells, where you belong!
Come on, you don't want to confess just a little bit?
NO! And you should all be behind bars!
Come on Arista, confess already!
Why did you try to frame us for murder?
How dare you come here and accuse me of framing anyone!
I won't be lectured by a bunch of train destroying fugitives!
Bergmann mishandled the estate's finances, isn't that right?
I say! T-there's no evidence for that, you know!
That would be hard to prove, Arthur!
All those records burned up in that little derailment of yours.
You tried to sell and Lady Unterwald caught onto your scheme, didn't she?
No, that's not true!
Lady Unterwald was leaving you nothing, and you couldn't stand it!
My d-dear sister would do no such thing!
You were parading around a phoney document, a forgery!
Lady Unterwald cut you out of her will, so you killed her!
NO! NO! NO!
Did anyone else feel that?
You're really testing my patience now!
Do you even need that hearing horn, Arista?
Of course I need it!
I'm a defenceless old lady, who's only crime is being hard of hearing!
You can't help but make baseless accusations, can you?
How could you manipulate your own sons into doing your dirty work?
My poor, incompetent boys?
Come now! They're far too stupid to have criminal intent!
You answer to me, now.
Inland Revenue will go through the estate with a fine-tooth comb!
Is that right?
Well, any responsibility will fall to Jian here, just as soon as he signs.
Mmhh! Mmhh!
You helped to build the Reuss Express, is that correct?
That's right, I designed her with my own two hands.
The Reuss Express could have been the future of rail transportation!
Thanks to you, it's a smouldering wreck!
And yet you were willing to throw away your future for a payout?
Jian Liu had no intention of using your technology, he just wanted to remove his competition.
I admire your idealism, but that's business, dear.
That's hardly a crime, it's just capitalism.
Lady Unterwald would have never allowed that to happen!
My dear sister didn't have the stomach to run an empire.
Sometimes you have to make the difficult choices, she never understood that!
You were tired of living in your sister's shadow, weren't you?
S-Stop it! Stop this at once!
It's not true!
Just admit it. You schemed to take her legacy and her life!
NO! NO! NO!
Huh, I felt the ground shake beneath my feet.
Were you and Mr Liu working together on this?
I don't know what you're talking about!
Just look at him, hasn't poor Jian suffered enough?
Mmmphf!
You were aware of Jian's attempts to inform on Lady Unterwald?
Jian has been nothing but loyal, I only wish my dear sister could have seen that.
He's even volunteered to take the estate off our hands for a very generous price.
Mmmff!!
Don't worry, Jian, our agreement is but a signature away!
You had to know we wouldn't just go quietly.
I'm sure the authorities are already en route.
If there is any justice, you'll be back behind bars in no time at all.
Now it's my turn.
You used me to fix your hearing horn, you made me an accessory!
I have to thank you for your assistance with that, detective.
I couldn't have used my horn otherwise.
My poor boys would have been lost in those vents for hours!
How deep does this conspiracy go, Arista?
There's no conspiracy, dear!
Then how do you explain my publishers denying ''The Suburban Burden''?
What's that? What on earth are you talking about?
Herman...
What? I think we can all agree it was a little suspicious.
The Order won't stand for this, you know!
The Order? Oh please, I set that whole thing up!
The Order was intended as an advisory board, to nudge my sister in the right direction!
Who do you think was doing the nudging?
Wait, you started The Order Of Idle Hands?
Indeed. It was all in my sister's best interest, of course!
I found them to be quite persuasive, before they got carried away with their own customs...
Alas, by the end, even poor Jian here couldn't get them to do his bidding!
Mmff.
Well, now we feel a bit used!
When did you last speak to Doctor Hirsch?
I can't recall, It's been a while since I saw him!
Are you sure you haven't seen the doctor?
Like I said, I wouldn't have a clue of his whereabouts!
Now stop asking!
Perhaps we should search the estate for Doctor Hirsch?
That won't be necessary!
I'm sure he's just been delayed, that's all!
I propose we start our search in the basement.
The Basement?
No, you can't!
NO! NO! NO!
What was that?
There's no need for anyone to venture into the basement, Herman!
''Keep Calm And Carry On''?
''Dance Like Nobody's Watching''?
''Live, Laugh, Love''?
Oh, I don't actually know.
''Dedicated to my beloved wife, my dear Moonhog''
''Dedicated to my beloved wife, my dear Junebug''
''Dedicated to my beloved wife, my dear Prune Club''
Hmm, I'll double-check.
I've heard it was a fist, raised in anger.
I believe the gesture was a peace sign.
It was crossing it fingers, for luck!
I'm not sure.
It was a single finger being held out.
It was two hands clasped together.
It was an open palm.
I must have forgotten.
Are you responsible for the death of Lady Unterwald?
The tragic death of Lady Unterwald will draw attention away from us.
We must seize this opportunity, Arthur.
So, did you murder Lady Unterwald?
Lady Unterwald's death has proved to be quite the distraction.
It's been a blessing for us, Arthur.
What's with all the high-tech monitoring equipment?
Lady Unterwald's rotten family has been evading us for a long time.
We can only put them behind bars if we have cold hard evidence.
Did Lady Unterwald mind you installing all of this gear?
I'm sure HQ briefed you on my mission, Arthur.
I'll soon figure out who's really running things...
What information do you want from me, exactly?
I need to see Lady Unterwald's final will and testament.
I'm already aware it's missing, so we need to work hard on getting it back...
or finding another copy, if she kept a backup.
Lady Unterwald might have kept a backup in her quarters.
I'll take another look around, and see what I can find.
Excellent.
I've found a hidden safe in Lady Unterwald's quarters.
Opening it could provide them with more information.
Agreed.
Get to it then, Arthur.
I'll continue to monitor the situation from here for now.
This isn't about Lady Unterwald's murder?
Lady Unterwald's death was unexpected.
However, I have to stay on mission.
Did you know the treasurer was cooking the books?
I found Bergmann's ledger hidden in a drawer.
Is that so? Let me have a look.
If Bergmann was really falsifying these records, this could be exactly the evidence we've been looking for!
Maybe I had you wrong, Arthur. You're sharper than you look.
Thank you?
Leave this with me.
I discovered the treasurer was being blackmailed.
Blackmailed? By whom?
A mobster by the name of Donny Donato.
Interesting. Do you have any evidence?
Ah... no.
Donny recorded their conversations, but he kept the tape recorder on him.
And where is he now?
I think he had a run in with the casino enforcers.
Maybe Donny left it behind? Just let me know if you find it.
I have evidence the treasurer was being blackmailed.
Blackmailed? By whom?
A mobster by the name of Donny Donato.
Interesting. Let's give it a listen.
That's ENOUGH, Donny.
Not only are you drawing attention to yourself, you're about to bankrupt the damn company!
I didn't tell you to fritter away her fortune, bet by bet.
Lady Unterwald is dead, don't you think they're going to start digging for a motive?
I've hidden the accounts in her quarters for now, but it's only a matter of time before someone starts snooping.
I'll bet the old bat took one look at the numbers in that ledger of yours and the shock killed her!
We'll need to confirm the authenticity of the recording, but this is strong evidence!
I found a hidden safe in Lady Unterwald's quarters!
A hidden safe? What was inside?
I'm not sure, I haven't been able to open it!
We should find a way to open it. It could contain evidence!
How low will you go? How high will you jump?
Aren't your eyes open? Are you not awake?
You need to climb lightly, be careful not to slip.
Are you watching closely? Did you see me make my move?
Are we shaking hands now?
I'm a little confused.
I don't understand.
I need a hint!
How does this work again?
Is this the real Dirk Chiselton?
Ah, you're wondering why a world-famous detective would be answering the phones instead of solving crimes?
I was wondering that!
It's because I'm a professional, and I'm an excellent multitasker.
That's right, I'm the real deal, kid.
Is this really Dirk Chiselton?
Like I said, I'm the real deal.
Now, do you have a question for me or not?
Oops, I don't need a hint right now!
I need a hint!
How does this work again?
I wouldn't think the I.R.S.S had the budget for Dirk Chiselton.
I'm an external contractor with competitive rates. What can I say?
Are you going to ask me a question or not?
I don't suppose you do house calls?
Depends, how big a house are we talking?
It's a mansion, if that helps.
Funny that, I'm on my way to a mansion right now.
Wonder if it's the same one!
I don't need a hint right now!
Alright, call back if you change your mind.
I need a hint!
How does this work again?
I never thought I'd be crawling to Dirk Chiselton for assistance.
Ah, there's no shame in asking for help!
Let's face it, we all need a hand from time to time.
And these calls are just between you and me, alright?
On second thought, I can do this all by myself!
Alright, but call back if you change your mind!
'Tis I, Herman Merman – detective extraordinaire!
Herman Merman? And that's your real name?
It is indeed!
So your parents were trying to make things difficult for you?
They were both quite eccentric, now that you mention it.
I don't doubt it.
The name is Jian Liu, I think you'll find me on the guest list.
Look, pal. You're not the first person to try and pass themselves off as someone on the list, okay?
Even if I wasn't so good at putting names to faces, I literally watched Jian Liu walk in ahead of you.
There's no need for these formalities, I'm a man of celebrity status!
Oof. Look, pal, I know talent when I see it.
If you were a celebrity, would I be asking for your name?
Don't you know who I am?
I'm not sure, am I supposed to know?
Herman Merman - detective extraordinaire!
And that's you?
You're absolutely positive that's your real name?
Yes, Herman Merman!
Objection!
Prepare to buckle under justice!
I have the power of attorney!
You betrayed the LAW!
Who are you, again?
What are you talking about?
Don't try to play coy with me, Mr Ackerman!
No, really, do I know you?
Jian Liu!?
Uh...
Wait... Lady Unterwald's suitor?
Do you know how long it took to get close to Lady Unterwald?
And just when I had her in the palm of my hand.
Who would show up and ruin the entire scheme but her meddling attorney!
I'm not sure why you're mad at me!
You not only stole my suit, but the estate I was working so hard to gain control of!
You might have got this far by playing dumb, but it won't help you now!
You're breaking the law, you know!
Eugh! You bureaucrats and your archaic rules!
I tried playing things by the book, and look where that got me!
I don't mind breaking a few rules if it means I get what I want!
How about we forget this whole thing ever happened?
Unacceptable, Mr Ackerman!
I'll be claiming the estate for my own, which makes you collateral damage, I'm afraid.
We can't have you walking around with a claim to my prize, after all!
Is that a real gun you're holding?
I can assure you it's very real.
Perhaps I should demonstrate?
That won't be necessary!
Where were you hiding that pistol?
Never you mind!
Actually, I think that's enough questions!
Very well...
What's the name of the band, then?
Lucky guess!
Wrong!
Nah, that's not right.
That ain't it.
Nice try, pal.
Gin and Bitters?
Lindy Hop Bop!
Charleston Jive?
The Big and Talls!
Balboa Sins!
Balboa Swing?
Balboa Sings!
Balboa Strings?
If you're such a fan, then you know all the songs, right?
What song plays before 'Freight Train Blues'?
Lucky guess.
No, that's not right.
Railroad Rhythm.
Whistle Stop Swing.
Whistle Stop Swing.
Boxcar Boogie.
Boxcar Boogie.
My Love is on the Line.
My Love is on the Line.
Freight Train Blues.
What song plays after 'Railroad Rhythm'?
Okay, you know your stuff!
Here, I've got something for you!
Is that...
Here, I'll sign it for you.
''Dear Herman Merman.''
''Thank you for being a fan!''
What an honour!
How did you know where to find us?
Let's just say we have a man on the inside.
They were able to alert us when you arrived here for interrogation.
Well? Who's your man on the inside?
What does it matter to you?
Besides, that's classified information.
Is anyone here who they say they are?
Strong talk from a self-declared detective that's never had a case, hmm?
Point taken, I suppose.
Well, what's your escape plan?
If you can get some leverage on those bars, I'll see if I can use the bike to force them open!
You say you're from the Inland Revenue Secret Service?
That's right. The names' April Benelli.
And you're one of three framed for murder.
Now that we've exchanged pleasantries, I believe there was a jailbreak in progress?
How do you know we were framed?
Well, I know Diana didn't do it.
Are you telling me you killed Lady Unterwald?
Well, there you go!
Tell me, why are you helping us?
They've got my partner locked up in there!
That's right. But we'll need all three of you if we're going to complete this mission.
You'll need me for your mission?
You've proven yourself capable. At least, you haven't gotten yourself killed.
There were admittedly a few near misses.
Even so, we'll have strength in numbers.
How am I supposed to bend these bars?
You won't be able to bend them with your bare hands, but they're structurally weak.
If you can find something to leverage against them, I think I could get you out of there!
Let me get back to you.
Fine, but be quick about it!
The bike really can't go any faster?
I'm already going full throttle!
We're going to have to boost the bike's speed if we stand a chance of catching up to the train!
How can I increase our speed if you're going full throttle!
Think, Diana! Maybe you have something that can help us out!
How are we doing for fuel?
We're doing okay, but that petrol you swiped earlier must've been old!
If only we had some high-octane stuff!
I just wanted to thank you for getting me here!
Don't mention it! You can thank me when you're on that train!
I think that's enough talk for now!
You're right!
How's the bike repair looking?
It looks like we're still missing fuel, and the wiring is completely shot.
Sorry to say, but we're not going anywhere until we've addressed that.
What's the status of the bike repair?
Well, it looks like we're all fuelled up. The tank's looking good!
Not so fast. We'll still need to get all this faulty wiring repaired.
We're not going anywhere until we've addressed that.
How's the bike looking now?
Our prospects are looking better now that we've replaced the wiring.
You know what? I think this old girl may just run again!
You're a genius, April!
Settle down, there's no need to inflate my ego just yet.
We're still missing fuel. If the tank is empty, we can't go anywhere!
How's the bike coming along?
We've got a full tank of petrol, and the wiring's all fixed!
You know what? I think we've only gone and done it!
You're serious? You fixed the bike?
I consider it a team effort, but yes. I've fixed the bike!
Just hop on whenever you're ready, and I'll get us out of here!
I'm ready to get out of here!
Alright! Hop on the back and I'll get the bike started!
I can't believe Mr Stamp cancelled my first mission!
I know! Phil is such a coward.
You know what they're like upstairs, though. It's all short-term thinking.
What's all this talk about budget cuts?
It doesn't make any sense, they were happy to spend millions on that R.A.T!
You mean the Rodent Agent Training programme?
Now that I think about it, that probably explains the money troubles.
I hope my equipment is still set up on the Reuss Express
I'm sure it is, do you know how slow retrieval is?
They've left our kit out in the field for months before.
I thought this was a test yard, what's with all the broken equipment?
Our field agents don't always bring their equipment back in one piece.
We're lucky if they bring back anything at all!
From what Phil said, it sounds like they already relocated anything useful.
What's with the pneumatic tubes?
It's a complete tube network! It's so the executives can send documents and small items down here remotely.
I guess they can't risk getting engine grease on their expensive suits.
You'll usually only find them in banks, hospitals or eccentric people's houses.
Do you know how the tubes work?
It's pretty easy. You just load a canister in the slot, and set the destination on the control panel.
Why? What are you up to?
Nothing, I was just curious!
I'll need to get my hands on some gadgets!
Well, normally you'd fill in a requisition form and hand it to the Quartermaster.
Although, with everything being shut down, I think you'll need to be a bit more creative!
The quartermaster won't let me have any gadgets!
Perhaps you can get what you need without involving the Quartermaster.
You mean, go behind her back?
I didn't say that. But hey, that's not a bad idea!
Alright, I think that's everything for now!
Okay, keep up the good work.
Yes. Now what of it?
Do you make a habit of bothering people and asking them stupid questions?
Of course! She even gave my boys cushy jobs in the family business.
Have you met them? They're imbeciles!
I did! I never shied away from getting my hands dirty, you see.
I'm an engineer at heart, always been fascinated by mechanisms!
You know, I even helped design the Reuss Express.
Oh yes, I know all her little quirks!
She's not your standard steam engine, you know.
She isn't?
You're travelling aboard one of the first steam turbine locomotives!
I'm talking about steam power, boy!
She may be experimental, but you're riding on the future of transportation.
Woah!
If you ask me, too many naysayers are betting on diesel.
They are?
The Reuss Express is a real challenge to that notion.
Oh, this? You've never seen an ear trumpet before?
I don't think so!
